thread:
incident-bot: PAGE: high 5xx rate from edge-config-v2 after staged flip. auto-alert triggered for region: apac-edge.

mira: seeing it too, rolling deployment reached ~18% of global traffic ~10m ago. errors spiking to 13% on POST /v1/generate in apac-edge.

devon: paging in, oncall. @mira -- can you confirm which subset got flipped?

mira: it was prefix-based split: client-ip prefix 203.0.113.* -> green (edge-config-v2). Canary was 5% but our edge-controller mistakenly applied to the /v1/generate route only, not the health checks.

sam: confirm errors are 500s with `KVCacheFailed` in logs and `cuda_alloc` spikes on a few hosts. logs: ```
2026-03-15T09:02:11Z host-az3-apac edge-proxy ERROR request_id=abc KVCacheFailed key=conv_...
2026-03-15T09:02:12Z host-az3-apac model-server ERROR OOM when allocating KV cache
```

priya: this is impacting customers on dedicated pools pinned to apac-edge as well — seeing elevated token latency and tail errors.

mira: quick mitigation option 1: flip the feature flag back (kill-switch). option 2: rollback the green cluster to blue config. flipping FF is faster.

devon: agree. I'll flip the FF first and monitor. executing kill switch now.

oncall-bot: @devon acknowledged. Handoff token: HND-9832.

devon: running admin toggle: ```bash
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" https://admin.redwood/v1/feature-flags/edge_config_v2 -d '{"enabled":false}'
```

devon: done. change propagated to edge-controller.

mira: see drop in new green traffic, but some sessions still route to green due to existing sticky cookies/connection reuse.

sam: tailing metrics: errors down from 13% -> 2.1% over last 3 mins. latency 95p improving.

kelly: pinging sales & cs about impacted customers. sending brief to account owners.

priya: can we get quick list of top affected customers and per-customer error rate?

sre-lead: pulled query against request logs, rough numbers: AcmeCorp (10k reqs, 18% errors), Finlytics (4.5k, 12%), RetailCo (2.2k, 9%). overall ~3% of total platform requests during window.

mira: starting incident severity calc: client-visible errors + degraded latency -> S2. Will notify support and post a status update.

devon: rolling back any in-progress deployments to known-good config for green instances as a safety. running `./deploy rollback --group=apac-edge --to-tag=edge-config-v1`

sam: small note: health checks for model-server were not included in the edge-controller rule set for the v2 flip, so unhealthy nodes stayed in pool. we should fix the controller config during postmortem.

mira: agreed. also add check to canary job: ensure health-check endpoints included and that sticky-cookie behavior is simulated.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: feature flag disabled at 09:12 UTC; traffic routing stabilized at 09:18 UTC. current status: mitigation in progress, customer notifications sent.

kelly: posted to #support with details and sent targeted DM to AcmeCorp CSM. asking for any customer-side logs.

priya: are SLA breach windows expected? Should we prepare credits?

sre-lead: SLO watch: error budget consumption spike but still within monthly threshold; manual review needed for any contractual credits. keep finance/sales in loop.

devon: monitoring for 30m, then we'll mark mitigated if no regression. creating temp dashboard with per-region 5xx and latency breakdown.

mira: assigning postmortem owner: mira. timeline notes recorded; please add exact times for flip, FF toggle, and when last green connection closed.

sam: flagged a follow-up to make edge flips idempotent and to add explicit drain period on connection reuse. ticket: INF-4721.

priya: anything customer-facing immediately? I can draft a short status page: "We experienced a partial rollout of a configuration change that caused elevated errors for a subset of APAC traffic. We disabled the change and traffic has returned to normal. We're investigating root cause."

mira: good. include impacted customer list (internal only) and that we're prepping a postmortem.

devon: confirming final status: all metrics stable for 12 minutes, no regressions. leaving page open for monitoring.

incident-bot: PAGE CLOSED: incident declared mitigated at 09:32 UTC. postmortem assigned to mira.

mira: thanks everyone. quick retrospective actions: 1) fix canary controller config, 2) add kill-switch runbook to oncall playbook, 3) automated sticky-cookie drain. I'll open PRs/tickets.

kelly: noted. I'll follow up with comms once postmortem draft is ready. :white_check_mark:

sre-lead: nice quick action on the kill-switch. we avoided a larger outage. postmortem due in 3 business days.

mira: closing thread to keep noise down — please add any stray logs or customer updates here if you have them."
